name: Triangle
summary: Steel orchestral triangle hanging on a loop with its beater; anim ring makes it chime. For music and percussion scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: y of the hanging loop (the triangle hangs below it)

params.name: s
params.note: scale; hero size: at s = 1 the triangle is about 300 px wide and 340 px tall

params.name: anim
params.note: ring = the triangle swings and shakes as if struck
